Describes daily hydropower-operation equations but does not establish the firm-power reliability criterion. MATLAB reservoirSimulator6_2.m, reservoirSimulator6_3.m, durationCurve.m and the supplied R scripts also did not establish the field calculation. The criterion remains unresolved.

decisions: Combine only KNN rows and the requested mean/firm power columns; add management code from filename. Preserve complete original 42-row files, including BCSD results and TotalSpills. No model rerun or scenario relabeling.
limitations: Management and climatology codes retain the source labels; their complete mapping to paper scenario names and periods needs confirmation.
These are modeled summary power estimates, not a daily power series or measured generation.
Firm_Energy_MW is reported in MW, but its reliability criterion is unresolved in the inspected sources.

scenario_context.mapping_status: Source files use E4 where the paper discusses S3; full source-to-paper code mapping remains to be verified. Original E codes are preserved.

source_bundle_note: All 16 original energy tables and both inspected scripts are retained in one ZIP. Each member is checked against its original source hash; the full membership and source mapping are recorded in preparation_checks.supporting_archives.

field_definitions.land_management: Added from exact source filename; not an inferred scenario name.
field_definitions.scenario: his occurs for E0 historical rows; historical occurs in other files. Both source labels are preserved. Future labels ssp126 and ssp585 refer to SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5.
field_definitions.climatology: 0 historical;1/2/3 ordered future groups. No specific observation timestamp is assigned.
field_definitions.Firm_Energy_MW: Modeled firm power, megawatts. The exact exceedance probability or reliability criterion has not yet been verified from the paper or inspected source algorithms; no standard percentile is assumed.
field_definitions.TotalSpills: Original source field retained in attachments; excluded from prepared power-only table because spill units were not verified.
